newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Stet to take stake in Mobilkom Austria.
newsitem.headline: Stet to take stake in Mobilkom Austria.

text.p: Austria's postal and telecommunications monopoly Post und Telekom Austria AG (PTA) said on Wednesday Italy's Stet SpA would form a strategic partnership with its Mobilkom Austria unit and acquire a 25 percent plus one share stake in the company.
PTA did not give any financial details of the deal, which it said was subject to regulatory clearance.
Stet had been competing against rival offers from Tele Danmark, the Unicom unit of the international Unisource alliance, and South Western Bell of the U.S.
PTA said it was advised by Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS) in the selection of its new strategic partner.
Mobilkom operates Austria's biggest global system for mobile communications (GSM) network with some 400,000 customers.

The Austrian government plans to award a third mobile phone licence this summer to further boost competition ahead of the planned liberalisation of the Austrian telecommunications sector in 1998, one year ahead of PTA's scheduled privatisation.
